When a Circular Measure candidate is accidentally inserted into `projection["nodes"]` with its candidate status, this boundary check does not detect it because procedure-instance IDs generated by the engine start with `procinst:`, not `pi::` (the checked cumulative projection already contains 72 such predecessor candidate nodes and zero IDs with this prefix). Since `projected_candidate_procedure_instances` is only a separate self-reported delta field, the validator can still return passing hard gates for a projection containing a newly exposed Circular Measure candidate. Cross-reference the projected node IDs against the current `candidates` set or their source artifact instead of testing this nonexistent prefix.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
